camel_example: aliyun dds DescribeRunningLogRecords --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime '2019-01-01T13:10Z' --PageSize 30 --ResourceGroupId 'sg-bpxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx' --QueryKeywords test_test2 --RoleType primary --LogicalOperator and --StartTime '2019-01-01T12:10Z' --RoleId 651xxxxx --OrderType asc --DBInstanceId 'dds-bpxxxxxxxx' --PageNumber 1 --NodeId 'd-bpxxxxxxxx' --DBName mongodbtest
description_en: View the running logs for a MongoDB instance
kebab_example: aliyun dds describe-running-log-records --db-instance-id dds-bpxxxxxxxx --node-id d-bpxxxxxxxx --start-time 2019-01-01T12:10Z --end-time 2019-01-01T13:10Z --db-name mongodbtest --role-type primary --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --order-type asc --resource-group-id sg-bpxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx --role-id 651xxxxx --query-keywords test_test2 --logical-operator and --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRunningLogRecords

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

If this parameter is set to the ID of a sharded cluster instance, you must also specify the NodeId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
当本参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，还需要传入NodeId参数
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of a mongos node or shard node in a sharded cluster instance.

This parameter is available only when the DBInstanceId parameter is set to the ID of a sharded cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中Mongos节点ID或Shard节点ID。

当DBInstanceId参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time is in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time is in UTC.

The end time can be up to 24 hours later than the start time. Otherwise, the call fails
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 查询结束时间距查询开始时间不得超过24个小时，超过则调用失败
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The role of the node. Valid values:

primary: The primary node.

secondary: A secondary node.

If the NodeId parameter is set to the ID of a mongos node, the RoleType parameter can only be set to primary
parameters.help_zh:
实例中节点的角色。取值：
primary：主节点。
secondary：从节点。

当NodeId参数传入的是Mongos节点ID时，RoleType取值只能为primary
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 30 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值范围为30~100。
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The sort order of the running logs to return. Valid values:

asc: ascending order

desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
按时间的升降序对查询到的运行日志进行排序。取值：
asc：按时间升序排序。
desc：按时间降序排序
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The role ID of the node. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62134.html operation to query the role ID
parameters.help_zh: 节点的角色ID。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62134.html进行查询
parameters.name: role_id

parameters.help_en: The keywords for the query. You can specify up to 10 keywords. Separate multiple keywords with spaces
parameters.help_zh: 查询关键字，多个关键字以空格分隔，不超过10个关键字
parameters.name: query_keywords
